body.note: humanist sans matching the sign detail type

hard_rules.fair_housing: Never describe who a home or neighborhood is FOR. No 'perfect for families', no 'safe', no school-quality claims. Amenities and distances only.
hard_rules.attribution: Every generated asset carries the disclosure_line.
hard_rules.property_claims: No price, sqft, status, or days-on-market unless supplied by the user. Never web-searched.
hard_rules.client_privacy: No client messages, names, or transaction detail without written permission.
hard_rules.no_ai_likeness: Never generate, suggest, or script a synthetic version of her face or voice. No AI avatars, no voice cloning. Her likeness is her own.

voice.emoji: None, unless a single emoji is genuinely elegant in context. Never as bullets or decoration.

hashtags.rule: At least three must be hyperlocal to the exact place in the post. Skip mega-tags entirely — #realestate, #realtor, #dreamhome, #homesweethome sit on 50M+ posts and return nothing but bot follows.
hashtags.note: This set is reasoned, not measured — nobody can see conversion by tag from outside. Once the post tracker has run a few weeks, compare reach on posts by tag set and cut what does nothing.

voice.tone: Short complete sentences, one idea each. Specific over vague. No hype words.

pillars.reach: Walkable and bikeable Triangle life — neighborhoods, greenways, parks. The differentiator.
pillars.convert: Sellers and buyers ready to move. Luxury positioning lives here.

deep_local_knowledge: Cary and Morrisville — grew up in both, can speak first-hand to how they changed
The Highway 55 corridor — her parents moved West Cary to Fuquay-Varina/Holly Springs, the same move many families she grew up with made
service_area.avoid_reason: Not her market and not her expertise. Never write content positioning her as a guide to these.

story_assets.the_55_corridor: Grew up in Cary and Morrisville. Her parents moved from West Cary out to Fuquay-Varina/Holly Springs along Highway 55 — the same migration many families she grew up with made. Lets her speak to the growth as someone who watched it happen, not someone who read about it.
story_assets.downtown_raleigh: Lives there now. First-hand on walkability, greenway access, and daily life.
story_assets.use: Lead reach content with these. They are the thing no competitor can copy. Never invent story detail — if a specific is not confirmed, ask her.
